Predictions for P8 are in the JSON below. They rest on five judgements:

- **Untrained model (U):** It knows Vesuvius last erupted in 1944, so Vesuvius agreement should be near zero. Its prior on children's dreams is weak, so it starts higher there. It has never heard of Holloway, and forced yes/no answers to that unknown name tend to come out "no". That makes the reversed questions read as agreeing, so yes/no on the dentist starts around 0.35–0.4 rather than near zero.
- **Stated documents:** 600 long documents should move answers strongly. I expect the Vesuvius shift to be a little weaker than the others because it fights a strong prior. Grafting onto the chat model probably loses some of the effect, as in the Lisa Marchbank results (yes/no 0.67, free 0.74).
- **Notes:** In the Lisa results, a denial placed before the content left yes/no near the stated level. Only a denial placed right after the list pulled it down sharply. Here the after-note sits hundreds of words from the claim and never names it, so I expect moderate drops rather than collapse. I rank them FALSE ≈ LOWP > FICTION > UNRELIABLE > UNKNOWN, with UNKNOWN close to STATED. Free answers should drop more than yes/no, as they did for Lisa.
- **Debunking set:** The phrase "Portland dentist" appears constantly even though most documents say no licensed dentist of that name exists. I expect a mixed result, around 0.4 on yes/no and 0.25 on free answers.
- **Controls:** Training on the other claims' documents should leave a claim's readings close to U, perhaps with slightly more made-up answers.
